_note: Chip classification on SARDet-100K (DESIGN.md section 4). METHOD, the backbone, the budget and the split are filled in by finetune_chips.py. data and train values are the A0/A1 ATRNet fine-tune values (Experiments/mobileNetv2_DINO/config_finetune.json) so the recipe is the same; only the chips and the 6-class head differ.

train.selection: epoch with the highest mean per-class accuracy on the selection chips (earliest on ties)
